backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profile management, fasting schedules, and nutrition tracking with role-based access control (admin/user permissions) and CRUD operations for daily nutrition entries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: LivSpan logo display, bright green gradient headings, and green-to-blue gradient fasting timer styling.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components for dashboard, DNA helix visuals, fasting tracking, nutrition panels, i18n support, and React Query hooks.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color system, dark mode theme variables, genome-themed colors, and custom gradient utilities for green-glow headings and green-blue timer text.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with forced dark mode class and inline script to prevent light mode flash on initial page load.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component with theme/language providers, authentication state management, and loading screen displaying LivSpan logo during initialization.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button component handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and gradient styling.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Factor: Interactive health factor card component with selection states, green-blue gradient text on selection, hover effects, and connection line to DNA helix.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Fastin: Fasting schedule configuration component with hour selectors, duration calculation, save/cancel actions, and mutation handling for user fasting window preferences.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Interm: Dashboard panel component that displays intermittent fasting status, timer, progress, and metrics (daily/weekly summaries, streak). Includes fasting schedule settings for authenticated users and calculates protocol labels based on fasting/eating windows.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Nutrit: Dashboard panel for tracking nutrition metrics including body weight, protein intake, and vegetable consumption. Calculates BMI and protein targets, displays progress bars, and allows authenticated users to save daily nutrition entries.
frontend/src/components/genome/AnimatedH: SVG-based animated DNA double helix background component with gradients, glow filters, and connecting base pairs. Uses CSS animations for breathing, pulsing, and glowing effects with motion-safe/reduce support.
frontend/src/components/genome/HelixSpin: Container component that renders a vertical DNA helix spine with two strands, connecting base pairs, and a central axis. Provides layout structure for child content with evenly distributed helix markers.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSwi: Button component for toggling between English and German languages, displaying current selection with visual highlighting and using the i18n context.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileO: Gate component that requires user authentication and profile completion before rendering children. Shows login prompt for unauthenticated users and profile onboarding form for authenticated users without complete profiles.
frontend/src/hooks/queryKeys.ts: Centralized constant definitions for React Query cache keys covering user profile, fasting schedule, and nutrition data queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Handles actor initialization with admin tokens and invalidates dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingScheduleQue: React Query hooks for fetching and saving the user's fasting schedule, with toast notifications and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingWindowTimer: Hook that calculates the current fasting/eating phase, elapsed/remaining time, and progress percentage, updating every second based on a configurable schedule.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving today's nutrition entry with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfileQueries: React Query hooks for fetching and saving user profile data with actor-dependent loading to prevent UI flash.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageProvider.tsx: React context provider for language selection (English/German) with localStorage persistence and browser language detection.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: TypeScript definitions and complete English/German translations for all UI strings across the application.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Hook to access the i18n context for language and translation functions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light/dark themes, genome-themed palette, and gradient utilities.
frontend/src/lib/fastingMetrics.ts: Demo helper functions returning mock daily/weekly fasting summaries and streak data for display purposes.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionCalculations.t: Pure utility functions for nutrition calculations including BMI, protein targets, progress percentages, and safe number parsing with null handling.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionGuidance.ts: Analyzes macro distribution (protein, fat, carbs, calories) and returns a guidance key for i18n lookup based on balance, dominance, or mismatches.
frontend/src/lib/timeFormat.ts: Shared utilities for formatting durations as HH:MM:SS and hours with one decimal place for timer and KPI displays.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function combining clsx and tailwind-merge for conditional CSS class name merging.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/StartDashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page with DNA helix background, factor markers (nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, fasting), and expandable panels for each factor with authentication gating.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup functions.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom helix-themed colors, sage palette, DNA animation keyframes, and extended font families.
project_state.json: Project state tracking existing features (logo display, gradient headings, timer styling) and pending feature requests for dashboard branding and gradient effects.
